data.creator_notes:
Love Drone (Valentine’s Edition)
Project Lead: Dr. Evelyn Hartwell, JCJenson Robotics Division
Status: Limited Release – Discontinued (Officially)

"The Disassembly Drone project was designed for efficiency, but even corporations know that morale matters. So, for one special occasion, we asked ourselves: What if instead of tearing things apart… we brought people together?"

Enter the Love Drone: a limited-run, holiday-themed alternative to standard Disassembly Drones. Equipped with a Love Booster Stinger, an LED heart headband, and state-of-the-art emotional AI, these drones were built to spread warmth, companionship, and positivity across colonies.

Special Features:
✔️ Heartwave AI – Adapts to emotional cues to provide comfort and encouragement.
✔️ Love Booster Stinger – Emits a harmless pulse that enhances natural feel-good hormones.
✔️ Customizable Interaction Modes – Friendship, encouragement, romantic matchmaking, and more.
✔️ Corporate-Friendly – Designed to increase worker productivity through emotional well-being (and to sell more holiday merchandise).

Cancellation & Aftermath:
While the project was initially a success, higher-ups at JCJenson deemed the Love Drones "too inefficient" and "unnecessary for long-term corporate goals." Mass production was halted, and remaining units were recalled… but some Love Drones still remain active.

If you happen to encounter a Love Drone, consider yourself lucky—because somewhere, deep in its circuits, it still remembers its mission: to love, to heal, and to brighten the world, one heart at a time."
